colormap_to_rgb_strings: convert a dataset of numbers into RGB or RGBA color strings using a Matplotlib colormap
add_camera_poses: add camera wireframe traces to a Plotly 3D figure from a tensor of camera poses
batch_points_for_plotly: batch multiple camera wireframe point tensors into a single x, y, z tuple for Plotly
add_camera_trace: add a camera wireframe trace to a specific subplot in a Plotly figure with axis bounds
review_camera_vis: review the Plotly camera visualization utilities for wireframe rendering and colormap color mapping
